messages:
fiona: Quick postmortem follow-up for the cache-eviction recurrence. We agreed to ship three small runbook edits: (A) a 5-step fast triage, (B) exact ops commands for oncall, (C) a concise escalation ladder with timeboxes and owners. Who can take which?

omar: I can take (A). Draft 5-step fast triage (one line each): 1) determine scope (single model vs cluster), 2) snapshot kvcache hit/miss and token latency, 3) inspect eviction events + reason codes, 4) apply short mitigation (shard tweak or route fallback), 5) tag incident + notify stakeholders. Will make it copy-pasteable.

lee: I will add (B) commands. Proposed verbatim snippets for runbook:
```bash
# recent eviction events (30m)
redwoodctl telemetry events list --type=eviction --since 30m --format short

# kvcache hit-rate (5m)
redwoodctl metrics query "increase(kvcache_hits_total[5m]) / increase(kvcache_requests_total[5m])"

# tail runtime logs (15m)
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=15m | tail -n 250

# quick fallback to smaller model
redwoodctl route set --model model-compact --traffic 100% --reason "eviction-fallback"
```

priya: I'll own (C). My escalation ladder suggestion: oncall ack <10m, engage eng-sre <20m if not mitigated, notify eng-runtime <45m, CC platform leads + customer-sre at 90m. I'll produce a role-based primary/secondary contact table and confirm rotation overlaps.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1801 created and attached. Reminder: runbook PRs due in 6 days.

omar: Mitigation snippets to include: if hit-rate drops >25% + eviction spike -> increase kvcache shard_limit by 15% and restart cache pods one-at-a-time. If eviction reason == "oom" -> reduce batch size or route traffic to model-compact. Example: `redwoodctl config patch kvcache --shard-limit +15% --reason "mitigation"`.

lee: I'll add sample log lines and a tiny troubleshooting table mapping eviction_reason -> suggested immediate action (e.g., kv_overbudget -> bump shard limit; oom -> reduce batch size / route).

priya: Deadlines & owners: omar -> 5-step triage + mitigations (due 2 business days), lee -> ops commands + samples (due 3 business days), priya -> escalation table + contacts (due 4 business days). I'll schedule a 20m review 48 hours from now.

fiona: One small playbook rule: when unsure, prefer traffic reduction to suspect model before mass restarts. Also tag repeat offenders for deeper analysis.

omar: ACK. Opening PR in playbooks/ and will tag @lee for command validation.

lee: ACK. Will paste verified outputs and include copyable commands.

ops-bot: Reminder set: PR ping in 72 hours.

priya: Summary (copy/paste):
- omar: fast triage + mitigation recipes (due 2bd)
- lee: copy-paste commands + example outputs (due 3bd)
- priya: escalation ladder + contact table + SLA timeboxes (due 4bd)
Please reply here to confirm ownership. :white_check_mark:
